unitTitle: The Shark Caller - Episode 2: Bad Magic
scanNote:
1-HIKOYA, 2-QISM - MAShQLAR BETI (47-bet).

Yuqorida o'ngda 'The Shark Caller - Episode 2'.

CHAP USTUN:
1) 'Look at the pictures on p. 46 and answer the questions.' To'rt savol, har birida A/B variant:
   1 What can you see near the canoe in picture 1? A dolphins B sharks
   2 What is the weather like in picture 2? A sunny B rainy
   3 Who is Senan arguing with in picture 5? A David B Mosan
   4 What is inside the coconuts? A bread B meat
2) 'Look at the pictures again. Who is:' a puzzled? (picture 1) ...... b scared? (picture 4) ...... c very angry? (picture 5) ...... d amused? (picture 8) ...... & ......
3) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen to the episode. Who says the following? Write D for David, S for Sandra, Se for Senan, or M for Mosan.' Olti iqtibos: 1 'Something is going wrong.' 2 'It looks like a storm is coming.' 3 'Someone has cast a spell on me.' 4 'David, we'll drown!' 5 'I did nothing!' 6 'That's how he was going to call the sharks!'
4) 'Read the episode and answer the questions.' 1 Why can't Senan move his arms? 2 What does David ask Sandra to give him? 3 Why is Senan angry with Mosan? 4 What did Senan put in the coconuts?
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Grammar: Conditionals Type 0'.
• OCh KO'K quti, oq katta harflar 'if ... + present ... + present': 'We can use conditionals Type 0 to talk about something which always happens as a result of something else.' To'q sariq qiya: 'If you HEAT water, it BOILS.' 'We can use WHEN instead of IF in conditionals Type 0.' To'q sariq qiya: 'If/When sharks SMELL meat, they GET ... excited.'

O'NG USTUN:
5) 'Expand the notes into full sentences, as in the example.' TO'RT SURAT raqamli: 1 jigarrang it (yaqin surat); 2 eski fotoapparat oldida ota va o'g'il; 3 chipta avtomati; 4 akvarel bo'yoqlar va mo'yqalam. Ostida ko'rsatmalar: 1 my dog/hear/the doorbell, it/bark; 2 press/this button, camera/take a picture; 3 you/put/money in the machine, it/give/you a ticket; 4 you/mix/red and yellow, you/get/orange. Ko'k qiya namuna: 'If/When my dog hears the doorbell, it barks.'
• OCh KO'K quti, oq katta harflar 'Time Words': 'We do not use WILL after the time words BEFORE, AFTER, WHILE, UNTIL, IF and WHEN; we use the PRESENT SIMPLE instead.' To'q sariq qiya: "Let's go before it STARTS raining. (NOT: ... before it will start ...)" (will start - chizib tashlangan). 'However WHEN can be used with WILL if it is a question word.' To'q sariq qiya: "I don't know WHEN Paul WILL COME. (question word)" / 'Please tell me WHEN Paul COMES. (time word)'
6) 'Put the verbs into the present simple or the future simple.' Olti gap: 1 Give me the paddle before we ...... (drown)! 2 If you ...... (not/do) something quickly, we'll be in trouble. 3 When ...... (the sharks/appear)? 4 My dog gets annoyed if you ...... (pull) his tail. 5 We'll talk to Mike about it when we ...... (go) back to England. 6 I won't do anything until everything ...... (be) ready.
7) a) 'Read the episode again and find three verbs in the present continuous and three verbs in the past simple.' b) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and follow the episode on p. 46, then act it out.'
8) 'Read the summary of the two episodes and underline the correct linking words.' Yirtiq qog'oz shaklidagi quti, matn 11 ta qalin juftlik bilan.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '47'.

SURATLAR BO'YIChA SAVOLLAR.

⚠ 'A CANOE':
  = kanoe, tor qayiq.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /kəˈnuː/ - 'kanu'.

⚠ 'TO ARGUE WITH SB':
  = kim bilandir bahslashmoq.
  ⚠ 'an argument' = bahs, janjal.

⚠ 'WHAT IS THE WEATHER LIKE?':
  = Ob-havo qanday?
  ⚠ 'like' oxirida - 'How is the
  weather?' ham mumkin.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures again. Who is: puzzled? (picture 1); scared? (picture 4); very angry? (picture 5); amused? (picture 8)
exercises.instructionUz: Suratlarga yana qarang. Kim: hayron? (1-surat); qo'rqqan? (4-surat); juda jahldor? (5-surat); xursand? (8-surat)
exercises.explanationUz:
HIS-TUYG'U SIFATLARI.

  puzzled = hayron, boshi qotgan
  scared = qo'rqqan
  angry = jahldor
  amused = ko'ngli ochilgan,
     xursand


JAVOBLAR:

  a puzzled (1-surat) → SENAN
    ('Something is going wrong')
  b scared (4-surat) → SANDRA
    ("we'll drown!")
  c very angry (5-surat) → SENAN
    ('You broke my spell')
  d amused (8-surat) → DAVID &
    SANDRA (jipda kulishyapti)


⚠ '-ED' SIFATLARI:

  puzzled, scared, amused - hammasi
  '-ed' bilan: ODAMNING HISSINI
  bildiradi.
  ⚠ '-ing' shakli SABABNI bildiradi:
     'a puzzling story' = hayron
     qoldiradigan hikoya
     'an amusing film' = kulgili film

items.en: 1 Why can't Senan move his arms?
items.answerEn: Because he thinks someone has cast a spell on him.
items.answerUz: Chunki u kimdir unga sehr qilgan deb o'ylaydi.

items.en: 2 What does David ask Sandra to give him?
items.answerEn: He asks her to give him the paddle.

items.en: 3 Why is Senan angry with Mosan?
items.answerEn: Because he thinks Mosan broke his spell.
items.answerUz: Chunki u Mosan sehrini buzdi deb o'ylaydi.

items.en: 4 What did Senan put in the coconuts?
items.answerEn: He put meat in the coconuts to attract the sharks.
items.answerUz: U akulalarni jalb qilish uchun kokoslarga go'sht solgan.

exercises.explanationUz:
0-TUR ShART GAPLARI
(CONDITIONALS TYPE 0).


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ShAKLI                          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  IF/WHEN + PRESENT SIMPLE,
  PRESENT SIMPLE

  'If you HEAT water, it BOILS.'
  'When sharks SMELL meat, they GET
   excited.'

  ⚠ IKKALA bo'lakda ham PRESENT
  SIMPLE - 'will' YO'Q!


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  MA'NOSI                         ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  HAR DOIM bo'ladigan NATIJA:
  tabiat qonunlari, odatlar,
  umumiy haqiqatlar.

  ⚠ 'if' = 'when' - bu turda
  ikkalasi bir xil ma'noda!


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  0-TUR va 1-TUR FARQI            ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  0-TUR: If you heat water, it
     BOILS. (har doim, qonun)
  1-TUR: If you heat the water,
     I'LL MAKE tea. (bir marta,
     kelajakda)

  ⚠ 1-tur 38-betda o'rganilgan.


⚠ 'TO HEAT':

  = isitmoq.
  ⚠ 'heat' (ot) = issiqlik.


⚠ 'TO BOIL':

  = qaynamoq / qaynatmoq.
  ⚠ 42-betdagi 9a mashqida.


⚠ 'TO GET EXCITED':

  = hayajonlanmoq.
  ⚠ 'get' + sifat = holat
  o'zgarishi.

points.en: We can use conditionals Type 0 to talk about something which always happens as a result of something else.
points.uz: 0-tur shart gaplarini boshqa narsa natijasida har doim ro'y beradigan narsa haqida gapirish uchun ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'as a result of' = ... natijasida.
⚠ HAR DOIM - qonun, odat.

points.en: If you heat water, it boils.
We can use when instead of if in conditionals Type 0.
If/When sharks smell meat, they get excited.
points.uz: Agar/Qachon akulalar go'sht hidini sezsa, hayajonlanadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to smell' = hidlamoq, hid sezmoq.
⚠ 'get excited' = hayajonlanmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Expand the notes into full sentences, as in the example.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'If/When my dog hears the
   doorbell, it barks.'


TO'LIQ JAVOBLAR:

  1 If/When my dog hears the
    doorbell, it barks.
  2 If/When you press this button,
    the camera takes a picture.
  3 If/When you put money in the
    machine, it gives you a ticket.
  4 If/When you mix red and yellow,
    you get orange.


⚠ 3-ShAXS BIRLIK '-S':

  'my dog HEARS', 'it BARKS',
  'the camera TAKES', 'it GIVES'
  ⚠ PRESENT SIMPLE - '-s' ni
  unutmang!


⚠ 'TO BARK':

  = hurmoq (it).


⚠ 'TO PRESS A BUTTON':

  = tugmani bosmoq.
  ⚠ 'push' ham mumkin.


⚠ 'TO MIX':

  = aralashtirmoq.
  ⚠ 'a mixture' = aralashma.


⚠ 'IT' - IT HAQIDA:

  'my dog ... IT barks' - hayvon
  uchun 'it'.
  ⚠ O'z uy hayvoni bo'lsa 'he/she'
  ham mumkin.
exercises.exampleEn: If/When my dog hears the doorbell, it barks.
exercises.exampleUz: Agar itim eshik qo'ng'irog'ini eshitsa, huradi.
modelAnswers: If my dog hears the doorbell, it barks.
When you press this button, the camera takes a picture.
If you put money in the machine, it gives you a ticket.
When you mix red and yellow, you get orange.
modelAnswersUz: Agar itim eshik qo'ng'irog'ini eshitsa, huradi.
Bu tugmani bossangiz, fotoapparat surat oladi.
Agar avtomatga pul solsangiz, u sizga chipta beradi.
Qizil va sariqni aralashtirsangiz, to'q sariq hosil bo'ladi.

exercises.explanationUz:
VAQT SO'ZLARIDAN KEYIN 'WILL' YO'Q.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  QOIDA                           ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  before, after, while, until, if,
  when + PRESENT SIMPLE
  (kelajak haqida bo'lsa ham!)

  ✓ "Let's go before it STARTS
     raining."
  ✗ "Let's go before it WILL START
     raining."


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  ISTISNO - SAVOL SO'ZI 'WHEN'    ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  'when' SAVOL so'zi bo'lsa (qachon?)
  → 'will' MUMKIN:

  "I don't know WHEN Paul WILL
   COME." (qachon kelishini
   bilmayman - SAVOL)

  'Please tell me WHEN Paul COMES.'
  (Pol kelganda menga ayting -
   VAQT)

  ⚠ FARQNI QANDAY BILISh:
  'when' ni 'qachon' deb tarjima
  qilsa bo'lsa → savol so'zi → will
  'when' ni '...ganda' deb tarjima
  qilsa bo'lsa → vaqt so'zi →
  present simple


⚠ 'WHILE':

  = ... paytida, ... ekan.
  ⚠ 'while' + PRESENT SIMPLE /
  CONTINUOUS.


⚠ 'UNTIL':

  = ... gacha.
  ⚠ 'till' - so'zlashuv shakli.
  ⚠ "I won't do anything UNTIL
  everything IS ready."

points.en: We do not use will after the time words before, after, while, until, if and when; we use the present simple instead.
points.uz: before, after, while, until, if va when vaqt so'zlaridan keyin 'will' ishlatmaymiz; o'rniga hozirgi oddiy zamonni ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ OLTI so'z: before, after, while, until,
if, when.

points.en: Let's go before it starts raining. (NOT: ... before it will start ...)
points.uz: Yomg'ir boshlanmasidan oldin ketaylik. (XATO: ... before it will start ...)

points.en: However when can be used with will if it is a question word.
points.uz: Biroq 'when' savol so'zi bo'lsa, 'will' bilan ishlatilishi mumkin.

points.en: I don't know when Paul will come. (question word) / Please tell me when Paul comes. (time word)
points.uz: Pol qachon kelishini bilmayman. (savol so'zi) / Pol kelganda menga ayting. (vaqt so'zi)

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs into the present simple or the future simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Fe'llarni hozirgi oddiy yoki kelasi oddiy zamonga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ JAVOBLAR:

  1 Give me the paddle before we
    DROWN!
    ⚠ 'before' → present simple
  2 If you DON'T DO something
    quickly, we'll be in trouble.
    ⚠ 'if' → present simple
  3 When WILL THE SHARKS APPEAR?
    ⚠ SAVOL so'zi 'when' → will!
  4 My dog gets annoyed if you PULL
    his tail.
    ⚠ 0-tur: if → present simple
  5 We'll talk to Mike about it when
    we GO back to England.
    ⚠ 'when' vaqt so'zi → present
    simple
  6 I won't do anything until
    everything IS ready.
    ⚠ 'until' → present simple


⚠ 3-BAND - YaGONA 'WILL':

  'When will the sharks appear?' -
  bu SAVOL (qachon?), shuning uchun
  'will'.
  ⚠ Savolda 'will' EGADAN OLDIN:
  'When WILL the sharks appear?'


⚠ 'TO GET ANNOYED':

  = jahli chiqmoq, bezovta bo'lmoq.
  ⚠ 'annoyed' - '-ed' sifati (his).


⚠ 'TO PULL':

  = tortmoq.
  ⚠ Aksi 'to push' = itarmoq.


⚠ 'A TAIL':

  = dum.
  ⚠ 'tale' (ertak) bilan BIR XIL
  o'qiladi: /teɪl/.


⚠ 'MIKE':

  1-qismdagi gazeta muharriri.

items.textEn: 1 Give me the paddle before we ___ (drown)!
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'before' → PRESENT SIMPLE.
⚠ 'before we will drown' - XATO.

items.textEn: 2 If you ___ (not/do) something quickly, we'll be in trouble.
3 When ___ (the sharks/appear)?
4 My dog gets annoyed if you ___ (pull) his tail.
5 We'll talk to Mike about it when we ___ (go) back to England.
6 I won't do anything until everything ___ (be) ready.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the episode again and find three verbs in the present continuous and three verbs in the past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Qismni qayta o'qing va hozirgi davomli zamondagi uchta fe'l va o'tgan oddiy zamondagi uchta fe'lni toping.
exercises.explanationUz:
46-BETDAN FE'LLAR.


PRESENT CONTINUOUS (be + -ing):

  'Something IS GOING wrong.'
  "It'S RAINING!"
  'a storm IS COMING'


PAST SIMPLE (o'tgan oddiy):

  'The man WAS right!'
  'You BROKE my spell.'
  'I DID nothing!'
  'that WAS certainly very
   interesting'


⚠ NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR:

  break - BROKE - broken
  do - DID - done
  be - WAS/WERE - been


⚠ 7b: 'Listen and follow the
  episode on p. 46, then act it
  out.' - audio kerak; keyin
  rollarga bo'lib o'ynang.

points.en: Present continuous: is going (wrong), is raining, is coming
points.uz: Hozirgi davomli: is going, is raining, is coming

points.en: Past simple: was (right), broke, did (nothing), was (interesting)
points.uz: O'tgan oddiy: was, broke, did, was

points.en: 7b) Listen and follow the episode on p. 46, then act it out.
points.uz: 7b) Tinglang va 46-betdagi qismni kuzatib boring, so'ng rollarda o'ynang.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Audio kerak.
⚠ 'to act out' = rollarda o'ynamoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the summary of the two episodes and underline the correct linking words.
exercises.instructionUz: Ikki qism xulosasini o'qing va to'g'ri bog'lovchi so'zlar tagiga chizing.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI QISMNING QISQAChA MAZMUNI.


TO'LIQ MATN:

  Sandra and David went to meet
  Senan 1) BECAUSE they wanted to
  write an article about a shark
  caller. Senan asked them to eat
  sweet potatoes 2) AND to go to bed
  early. The next morning, 3) AS they
  were leaving the beach, they saw a
  man, Mosan. He was very angry with
  Senan 4) AND cursed him. 5) WHEN
  Sandra, David and Senan were in the
  canoe, Senan started beating the
  water with coconut shells. Some
  fins appeared. Sandra thought they
  were sharks, 6) BUT they were
  dolphins. Senan was surprised
  7) BECAUSE his magic didn't work.
  Suddenly, it started raining
  8) AND David asked Senan to take
  them back to the shore. Senan
  couldn't move his arms, 9) SO David
  asked Sandra to give him the
  paddle. 10) WHEN they were back on
  the shore, Mosan and Senan had an
  argument. David and Sandra decided
  to leave the village. 11) AFTER
  they left the village, Sandra found
  some meat in one of Senan's
  coconuts.


⚠ BOG'LOVChILAR:

  because = chunki (SABAB)
  so = shuning uchun (NATIJA)
  and = va (QO'ShISh)
  but = lekin (QARAMA-QARShILIK)
  when = ...ganda (VAQT)
  as = ... ekan, ... paytida (VAQT)
  after = ...dan keyin
  before = ...dan oldin
  until = ...gacha
  while = ... paytida


⚠ 'BECAUSE' va 'SO' FARQI:

  A because B = A, chunki B
     (B - sabab)
  A so B = A, shuning uchun B
     (B - natija)

  9-band: 'Senan couldn't move his
  arms, SO David asked ...' -
  NATIJA → 'so'.


⚠ 'AS' = 'WHILE':

  3-band: 'AS they were leaving the
  beach' = plyajdan ketayotgan
  paytda.
  ⚠ 'until' mos emas: 'ketguncha
  ko'rdi' ma'nosiz.


⚠ 'TO CURSE':

  = la'natlamoq.
  ⚠ 1-qism nomi 'The Curse' = la'nat.


⚠ 'A FIN':

  = suzgich (baliq, akula).


⚠ 'TO HAVE AN ARGUMENT':

  = janjallashmoq.
  ⚠ 'to argue' (fe'l).
